_doc: Narration tones shared by tools/tts/voice.py (voice, speed, pause) and the animation (energy). An episode picks one with "tone"; scenes may override it. The channel has ONE narrator: a calm British naturalist (bf_emma) - she is the channel's identity.

documentary.label: Default: deadpan nature-documentary narration about the human specimen

deep.label: The field note / life lesson - slower, more air

funny.label: Comedy beats and the 'Perfectly human' sign-off - quicker, snappier
